title: Blondie
paragraphs: Preservation subset of the 1939-1950 radio sitcom adapted from Chic Young’s comic strip. The frozen container also includes one Abbott & Costello guest broadcast and one promotional track, plus alternate AFRS/collection transfers; these are separated from the regular Blondie chronology.

The run breaks into several distinct periods: CBS / Camel era (July 3, 1939 to June 26, 1944) on [[org|org.8480b75bc0c36e4b|CBS Radio Network]], Blue Network / Super Suds summer run (July 21, 1944 to September 1, 1944) on [[org|org.acb290b0843b31ec|Blue Network]], CBS / Super Suds era (August 13, 1944 to September 26, 1948) on [[org|org.8480b75bc0c36e4b|CBS Radio Network]], and NBC / Super Suds era (October 6, 1948 to June 29, 1949) on [[org|org.f2f0561f0ce2ddc5|NBC Radio Network]].

Names that turn up again and again in the surviving run include Arthur Lake (performer), Penny Singleton (performer), Chic Young (creator), Hanley Stafford (performer), Bill Goodwin (announcer), Billy Artz (conductor), and Lenny Conn and His Orchestra (performer).

Across its run, the surviving broadcasts are tied to [[org|org.8480b75bc0c36e4b|CBS Radio Network]], [[org|org.4798d1172deaae2c|Armed Forces Radio Service]], [[org|org.f2f0561f0ce2ddc5|NBC Radio Network]], and [[org|org.0d7b5c86680811cc|ABC Radio Network]].

The stories often return to family and domestic comedy, marriage and household mishaps, children and family life, workplace comedy and Mr. Dithers, holiday and seasonal comedy, and celebrity guest and cross-series comedy.

The show also sits in a wider radio history that includes Comic strip characters move into film and radio, Sponsor and network transitions in commercial radio, AFRS reuse and preservation, and Domestic situation comedy in network radio.

If you are following the same actors and creative circles, related programs worth opening next include [[show|lux-radio-theatre|Lux Radio Theatre]], [[show|screen-directors-playhouse|Screen Directors Playhouse]], [[show|the-abbott-and-costello-show|The Abbott and Costello Show]], [[show|sears-radio-theater|Sears Radio Theater]], and [[show|cbs-radio-workshop|CBS Radio Workshop]].
